## STRATEGIES AND HARD RULES
[shr-00001] When an object is found in a location that does not match the task description (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), stop interacting with it and conclude the task as failed or incomplete.
[shr-00008] When the object is not immediately visible at the target location (e.g., the bowl is not on the coffeetable), systematically search for the object in the room by visiting other relevant locations (e.g., dining tables, drawers, sidetables) before concluding the object is unavailable.
[shr-00009] When multiple similar object types exist in the environment (e.g., multiple dining tables or drawers), systematically iterate through them in a logical order (e.g., left to right, top to bottom) to ensure no potential location is overlooked during the search.
## VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
[vc-00002] Before interacting with an object, verify that it is in the correct location relative to the task description (e.g., 'under the desklamp').

[vc-00007] When the task does not involve a spatial relationship (e.g., 'put a book in sofa'), skip additional verification actions like 'look under' or 'examine under' and proceed directly to interacting with the object.
